-- Proto_Au
SL_Ctx.Proto_Au = function(q, O, Q, m, d, _, C, B, V) if Q <= 10 then
	if Q <= 9 then

		return 7, C, 3 + V, d, B
	end

		local Q, d, _ = C [5], C [3], C [4]
		local h, r = Q + d, d <= 0

		return 8, C, V, h, B

		return 1, C, V, O, B
	end

		local Q = q [34](m, V + 1)
		return not(128 > Q) and 4 or 2, C, V, O, Q
	end
end

	local
	function Fw(Xw, Pw, pw) aw(Pw, "State")
	assert(Pw.Window == Xw.Section.Tab.Window, "State and Feature must belong to the same Window")
	local Ew = {FromOption = pw.OptionToState, ToOption = pw.StateToOption}
	Xw.State = Pw
	Xw._stateBinding = Ew
	Pw._views [Xw] = Ew
	if notPw._primaryOption or type(Pw._primaryOption._userCallback) ~= "function" and type(Xw._userCallback) == "function" then
	Pw._primaryOption = Xw
end
	iw(Pw)
end
	local
	function iw(Xw, Pw, pw, Ew) local Jw = setmetatable({_kind = "Option", _destroyed = false, _controller = Ew or {}, _manualVisible = true, _resolvedVisible = true, _visibilityDependencies = {}, _visibilityDependents = {}, Section = Xw, Type = Pw, Name = pw.Name, Instance = pw}, z)
	table.insert(Xw.Options, Jw)
	return Jw
end
	xw [29] =
	function(Xw) aw(Xw, "Option")
	local Pw = Xw._controller.GetValue
	if Pw then
	return Pw()
end
	return nil

	xw [30] =
	function(Xw, Pw, pw) aw(Xw, "Option")
	local Ew = Xw._controller.SetValue
	assert(Ew, ("%s khong ho tro Set()"):format(Xw.Type))
	if Xw.State and notXw._stateApplying then
	Ew(Pw, false)
	local Jw = Xw._controller.GetValue()
	local gw = Rw(Xw._stateBinding.FromOption, Jw, Ww(Jw), Xw, Xw.State)
	Hw(Xw.State, gw, pw, Xw)
	if pw ~= false and notUw(Xw.State) then
	Vw(Xw._userCallback, Xw._controller.GetValue())
end
	return Xw
end
	Ew(Pw, pw)

	local
	function hw() local uw = {}
	for Rw, Nw in ipairs(w.Tabs) do
	if notNw._destroyed then
	Rw = {}
	for Sw, iw in ipairs(Nw.Sections) do
	if notiw._destroyed then
	Sw = {}
	for Uw, Hw in ipairs(iw.Options) do
	if notHw._destroyed and notHw._configIgnored and Hw._controller.GetValue and not(Hw.State and Hw.State._registered) then
	local Tw, Fw = pcall(
	function()
	return Hw:Get()
end
	)
	if Tw and Fw ~= nil then
	Uw = Ww(Fw)
	if Uw ~= nil then
	local Tw = {Type = Hw.Type, Value = Uw}
	if Hw._controller.GetUnit then
	local Uw, Fw = pcall(
	function()
	return Hw:GetUnit()
end
	)
	if Uw and type(Fw) == "string" then
	Tw.Unit = Fw
end
end
	Sw [Hw.Name] = Tw
end
end
end
end
	if next(Sw) ~= nil then
	Rw [iw.Name] = Sw
end
end
end
	if next(Rw) ~= nil then
	uw [Nw.Name] = Rw
end
end
end
	return uw
end
	local
	function uw() local Rw = {}
	for Nw, Sw in ipairs(w.States) do

	Nw = Ww(Sw:Get())
	if Nw ~= nil then
	Rw [Sw.Name] = {Value = Nw}
end
end
end
	return Rw
end

	function Sw() local iw = Rw
	if iw then
	return

	Nw = hw()

	hw =
	function() local Yw = {}

	return

	function ow(Mw) if type(Yw) ~= "function" then

	return nil, "Selected config does not exist."

	return nil, "Selected config file is empty or invalid."

	jw.Profile = cw

	function() local ew = {Format = "ChilliLibraryConfig", ExportVersion = 1, Name = cw, Config = jw}
	return _w:JSONEncode(ew)

	return nil, "Config export encode failed: " .. tostring(vw)

	local
	function Mw(cw) local jw = tostring(cw or "")
	jw = jw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
	if jw == "" then
	return nil, nil, "Paste exported config JSON first."
end
	if #jw > 1048576 then
	return nil, nil, "Import is larger than the 1 MB safety limit."
end
	local vw, ew = pcall(
	function() local kw = jw
	return _w:JSONDecode(kw)
end
	)
	if notvw or type(ew) ~= "table" then
	return nil, nil, "Import text is not valid JSON."
end
	vw, cw = nil
	if ew.Format == "ChilliLibraryConfig" and type(ew.Config) == "table" then
	vw, cw = ew.Name or ew.Profile or ew.Config.Profile, ew.Config
else
		if type(ew.Values) == "table" or type(ew.States) == "table" then
		vw = ew.Profile
	else
		return nil, nil, "JSON is not a Chilli config export."
	end
	cw = ew
end
	local _w, jw = yw(vw)
	if not_w then
	return nil, nil, "Exported config name is invalid: " .. tostring(jw)
end
	if type(cw.Values) ~= "table" and type(cw.States) ~= "table" then
	return nil, nil, "Imported config has no States or Values."
end
	return _w, {States = type(cw.States) == "table" and Ww(cw.States) or {}, Values = type(cw.Values) == "table" and Ww(cw.Values) or {}}
end
	local
	function _w(Ww, cw) local jw = utf8.len(Ww)
	if notjw or jw <= cw then
	return Ww
end
	jw = utf8.offset(Ww, cw + 1)
	return jw and Ww:sub(1, jw - 1) or Ww
end
	local
	function Ww(cw) if notVw(cw) then
	return cw
end
	local jw = 1
	while true do
	local vw = "." .. tostring(jw)
	local ew = _w(cw, 48 - #vw):gsub("[%.%s]+$", "")
	local _w = (if ew == "" then
	"Imported"
else
		ew) .. vw
		if notVw(_w) then
		return _w
	end
	jw += 1
end
end
	local
	function _w() Sw()
	Jw += 1
	Dw.Loading = true

	function() local vw, ew, kw = {}, ipairs, w.States

	Iw:Set(Rw.Value, false)

	kw, ew = ipairs, w.Tabs
	for Rw, ww in kw(ew) do

	if type(Nw) == "table" then
	for Rw, ew in ipairs(ww.Sections) do
	Rw = Nw [ew.Name]
	if type(Rw) == "table" then
	for Nw, Nw in ipairs(ew.Options) do
	local ew = Rw [Nw.Name]
	if notNw._destroyed and notNw._configIgnored and type(ew) == "table" and ew.Value ~= nil and Nw._controller.SetValue and not(Nw.State and Nw.State._registered and vw [Nw.State]) then
	if type(ew.Unit) == "string" and Nw._controller.SetUnit then
	pcall(
	function() Nw:SetUnit(ew.Unit, true)

	)
	Nw:Set(ew.Value, true)

		Nw:Set(ew.Value, false)
	end
end
end

end
end
end
end
	,
	function(Rw)
	return tostring(Rw)
end
	)

-- Proto_q
SL_Ctx.Proto_q = function(q, O, Q, m, d, _, C, B) if _ <= 7 then
	local V = q [34](C, O)
	return not(V >= 128) and 41 or 60, O, Q, B, V
elseif _ <= 8 then
		local _ = q [34](C, 3)
		local V, h, r, Z = (O - 128) * 2097152, (Q - 128) * 16384, d - 128, _ % 128 * 128
		return 139, r + ((_ - _ % 128) * 2097152 + h + (Z + V)), 4, B, m
	else
		local d = q [34](C, 2 + O)
		return notnot(128 <= d) and 106 or 119, O, Q, d, m
	end
end

-- Proto_Uu

	local h = q [34](Q, 3 + d)
	local r, Z, L, u = 2097152 * (V - 128), (m - 128) * 16384, C - 128, h % 128 * 128
	local C = r + (L + (Z + (h - h % 128) * 2097152 + u))
	return 40, 4 + d, O, C, m
elseif _ <= 35 then
		local _ = q [34](Q, 1 + d)
		return not(_ >= 128) and 28 or 15, d, O, V, _
	else
		local q, Q = (O - 128) * 16384, B - 128
		local O = 128 * V + q + Q
		return 4, 3 + d, O, V, m
	end
end

-- BuildUI_Canvas
SL_Ctx.BuildUI_Canvas = function(q, q, q)

	function() local q, d = {Cards = {}, Rows = nil, Header = nil}

	)

	local
	function B(V) if typeof(V) ~= "Instance" or notV:IsDescendantOf(game) then

-- Proto_Ju
SL_Ctx.Proto_Ju = function(q, O, Q, m, d, _, C, B, V, h, r, Z, L) if Z <= 28 then
	if Z <= 27 then
	local u = q [34](m, O)
	return notnot(128 <= u) and 26 or 32, O, V, Q, _, u
else
		local u, b = C [7] [d], C [6]
		local d = u + 1
		u = q [34](b, d)
		return not(u < 128) and 12 or 20, O, b, d, u, h
	end
elseif Z <= 29 then
		local d = q [34](m, 3 + O)
		local q, m, C, Z, u = (h - 128) * 2097152, (B - 128) * 16384, r - 128, 128 * (d % 128), d % 128
		local B = 2097152 * (d - u)
		u = q + m + (Z + B) + C
		return 31, O + 4, V, Q, _, u
	else
		local q = L [4]
		if notnotq then
		return 0, q, V, Q, _, h
	else
		return 33, O, V, Q, _, h
	end
end
end
